new_public_specifications.statement:
specification token_attn_llama2_fp_backend_correctness
    {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (p : FPValue.Parameters)
    (s : State α) (hw : FPValue.WritesApart p s) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec M (FPValue.source p) s = some final ∧

new_public_specifications.scope: Full original accepted stage; concrete bit mul/add and named tree; arbitrary Real scale

new_public_specifications.name: token_attn_llama2_fp_software_correctness
new_public_specifications.statement:
specification token_attn_llama2_fp_software_correctness
    [Inhabited FPValue.Word] (rest : Algebra FPValue.Word) (cfg : FP.Config)
    (plans : ∀ n, ReductionPlan n) (encode : ℝ → FPValue.Word)
    (p : FPValue.Parameters) (s : State FPValue.Word) (hw : FPValue.WritesApart p s) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec (FPValue.softwareBackend rest cfg plans encode)
        (FPValue.source p) s = some final ∧
      FPValue.Post p s final
        (FPValue.wordScore cfg plans (FPValue.scaleWord encode p.scale) p s)

new_public_specifications.scope: All rational scalar values q, all accepted layouts/dimensions/branches, all Q/K fp32 payload bits, arbitrary valid width-indexed trees and FP.Config
new_public_specifications.remaining_numeric_parameter: No fallback callback in reference; runtime ABI and GPU/tree/FP profile binding remain external

new_public_specifications.name: token_attn_llama2_fp_rational_correctness
new_public_specifications.statement:
specification token_attn_llama2_fp_rational_correctness
    [Inhabited FPValue.Word] (rest : Algebra FPValue.Word) (cfg : FP.Config)
    (plans : ∀ n, ReductionPlan n) (q : Rat) (p : FPValue.Parameters)
    (s : State FPValue.Word) (hw : FPValue.WritesApart p s) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec
        (FPValue.softwareBackend rest cfg plans (FPValue.rationalEncoder cfg q))
        (FPValue.source {p with scale := (q : ℝ)}) s = some final ∧
      FPValue.Post {p with scale := (q : ℝ)} s final
        (FPValue.wordScore cfg plans (FP.round .fp32 cfg q) {p with scale := (q : ℝ)} s)

all_named_proof_declarations.name: source_body
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem source_body (p : Parameters) : (source p).surfaceBody =
    prelude p ++ [.forRangeDyn "start_mark" (.constNat 0) (.ref .nat [] "block_mask")
      (.constNat 1) (body p)]

all_named_proof_declarations.name: preExecution_mem
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
@[simp] theorem preExecution_mem {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (p : Parameters) (s : State α) :
    (preExecution M p s).val.mem = s.mem

all_named_proof_declarations.name: preExecution_mask
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
@[simp] theorem preExecution_mask {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (p : Parameters) (s : State α) :
    (preExecution M p s).val.regs .nat [] "block_mask" =
      some (fun _ => if blockActive p s then 1 else 0)

all_named_proof_declarations.name: execution_memory
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem execution_memory {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (p : Parameters) (s : State α) :
    (execution M p s).val.mem = (written M p s).mem

all_named_proof_declarations.name: written_readback
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem written_readback {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (p : Parameters) (s : State α)
    (hw : WritesApart p s) (i : Index p) (hb : blockActive p s) (hi : active p s i) :
    (written M p s).mem p.output (outputOffset p s i) = .mk .fp32 (score M p s i)

all_named_proof_declarations.name: written_frame
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem written_frame {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (p : Parameters) (s : State α)
    (r : RegionName) (o : Nat)
    (h : ¬ blockActive p s ∨ r ≠ p.output ∨ ∀ i, active p s i → o ≠ outputOffset p s i) :
    (written M p s).mem r o = s.mem r o

all_named_proof_declarations.name: correctness
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (p : Parameters) (s : State α)
    (hw : WritesApart p s) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec M (source p) s = some final ∧ Post p s final (score M p s)

all_named_proof_declarations.name: products_software
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem products_software [Inhabited Word] (rest : Algebra Word) (cfg : FP.Config)
    (plans : ∀ n, ReductionPlan n) (encode : ℝ → Word) (p : Parameters) (s : State Word) :
    products (softwareBackend rest cfg plans encode) p s = wordProducts cfg p s

all_named_proof_declarations.name: score_software
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem score_software [Inhabited Word] (rest : Algebra Word) (cfg : FP.Config)
    (plans : ∀ n, ReductionPlan n) (encode : ℝ → Word) (p : Parameters)
    (s : State Word) (i : Index p) :
    score (softwareBackend rest cfg plans encode) p s i =
      wordScore cfg plans (scaleWord encode p.scale) p s i

all_named_proof_declarations.name: rational_scale
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem rational_scale (cfg : FP.Config) (q : Rat) :
    scaleWord (rationalEncoder cfg q) (q : ℝ) = FP.round .fp32 cfg q

all_named_proof_declarations.name: software_correctness
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem software_correctness [Inhabited Word] (rest : Algebra Word) (cfg : FP.Config)
    (plans : ∀ n, ReductionPlan n) (encode : ℝ → Word) (p : Parameters)
    (s : State Word) (hw : WritesApart p s) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec (softwareBackend rest cfg plans encode) (source p) s = some final ∧
      Post p s final (wordScore cfg plans (scaleWord encode p.scale) p s)

all_named_proof_declarations.name: rational_correctness
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem rational_correctness [Inhabited Word] (rest : Algebra Word) (cfg : FP.Config)
    (plans : ∀ n, ReductionPlan n) (q : Rat) (p : Parameters)
    (s : State Word) (hw : WritesApart p s) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec (softwareBackend rest cfg plans (rationalEncoder cfg q))
      (source {p with scale := (q : ℝ)}) s = some final ∧
      Post {p with scale := (q : ℝ)} s final
        (wordScore cfg plans (FP.round .fp32 cfg q) {p with scale := (q : ℝ)} s)

all_named_proof_declarations.name: inactive_memory
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem inactive_memory {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (p : Parameters)
    (s : State α) (hb : ¬ blockActive p s) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec M (source p) s = some final ∧ final.mem = s.mem

all_named_proof_declarations.name: source_projection
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem source_projection (p : Parameters) :
    (source p).eraseDType.surfaceBody = (legacySource p).eraseDType.surfaceBody

all_named_proof_declarations.name: witness_scalar_rounding
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem witness_scalar_rounding :
    FP.round .fp32 .ieeeValue witnessScale = one ∧
    FP.mul .ieeeValue (FP.add .ieeeValue
      (FP.mul .ieeeValue one one)
      (FP.add .ieeeValue (FP.mul .ieeeValue tiny one) (FP.Value.zero .fp32))) one = one ∧
    witnessScale * witnessScale ≠ 1

all_named_proof_declarations.name: witness_score
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem witness_score [Inhabited Word] :
    wordScore .ieeeValue ReductionPlan.withSeed (FP.round .fp32 .ieeeValue witnessScale)
      witnessParameters witnessInitial witnessLane = one

all_named_proof_declarations.name: witness_layout
all_named_proof_declarations.statement: theorem witness_layout [Inhabited Word] : WritesApart witnessParameters witnessInitial

all_named_proof_declarations.name: nonempty_bit_success
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_bit_success [Inhabited Word] (rest : Algebra Word) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec
      (softwareBackend rest .ieeeValue ReductionPlan.withSeed (rationalEncoder .ieeeValue witnessScale))
      (source witnessParameters) witnessInitial = some final ∧
      final.mem "Out" 5 = .mk .fp32 one ∧
      final.mem "Out" 6 = witnessInitial.mem "Out" 6 ∧
      final.mem "Q" 0 = witnessInitial.mem "Q" 0 ∧ witnessScale * witnessScale ≠ 1

all_named_proof_declarations.name: token_attn_llama2_fp_bit_success
all_named_proof_declarations.statement:
theorem token_attn_llama2_fp_bit_success
    [Inhabited FPValue.Word] (rest : Algebra FPValue.Word) :
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec
        (FPValue.softwareBackend rest .ieeeValue ReductionPlan.withSeed
          (FPValue.rationalEncoder .ieeeValue FPValue.witnessScale))
        (FPValue.source FPValue.witnessParameters) FPValue.witnessInitial = some final ∧
      final.mem "Out" 5 = .mk .fp32 FPValue.one ∧
      final.mem "Out" 6 = FPValue.witnessInitial.mem "Out" 6 ∧
      final.mem "Q" 0 = FPValue.witnessInitial.mem "Q" 0 ∧
      FPValue.witnessScale * FPValue.witnessScale ≠ 1

accepted_scope: arbitrary dimensions,strides,program IDs,groups,max length and metadata
axis1 multiply/reduce followed by arbitrary scalar multiply
active output readback and whole-memory frame

assumptions.layout: Injective output addresses for active lanes; same accepted original layout premise
assumptions.domain: Existing Nat address/metadata model; no new finite/nonzero/positive/shape restriction; original Real host scalar cannot represent NaN/Inf or zero sign

witness.role: ordinary theorem; not a specification or full-task model upgrade

native_obligations.formula: scaleBits = runtime fp32 encoding of sm_scale; rational path round_fp32(cfg,q) for q equal to exact finite host value
native_obligations.limits: Real cannot distinguish host signed zero or represent NaN/Inf; q-specialized encoder is only valid for source scale q and explicit zero literal

native_obligations.formula: native axis1 reduction = treeValue_cfg(plan[BD], products), preserving all leaves/padding
native_obligations.limits: Compiler/layout/warp/fusion binding required; no associativity or all-tree equality assumed

native_obligations.formula: native products and scale multiply = FP.mul cfg; tree adds = FP.add cfg
native_obligations.limits: Instruction dtype, rounding, DAZ/FTZ, NaN policy and contraction must match; no GPU execution claimed

native_obligations.formula: physical fp32 Q/K/output payloads and Nat metadata/address reference match runtime pointers/metadata
native_obligations.limits: Added same-format register/store cast numeric identities proved in software profile; fixed-width metadata overflow not newly proved
